quantity: Vertical span of the connected above-threshold signed along-editorial-route model velocity component containing the strongest qualifying native0-200m core at a frozen sampled node.
upper_boundary: First adjacent upward crossing through threshold from the core; if contiguous above-threshold support reaches model depth0m, use the model surface. A shallowest sample deeper than0m is censored, not a surface boundary.
lower_boundary: First adjacent downward crossing through threshold from the same core. Missing/dry support or end of vertical domain before crossing leaves the boundary unknown. No jump to disconnected deeper flow.
thickness: Lower minus upper depth, in metres, only when both connected boundaries resolve. Lower contour depth alone is not thickness. Surface bounded layers are distinct from upper isotach crossings.
selection: Keep the v2 selected horizontal node exactly, including edge maxima and unresolved-axis status. Alternate thresholds diagnose their own qualifying core at that same node, as in v2. Also retain all five offsets for support audit; never substitute a more convenient resolved node.
source_scope: Two instantaneous2022 HYCOM snapshots, seven editorial EAC route vertices, five offsets per vertex, forty interpolated standard-depth levels. This is not a monthly climatology or a validated named-current axis.
processing_policy: Cloud only, one idle CPU; frozen retained source bytes, no network model retrieval, no local tests or ocean-field processing. No integration across gaps, no area or volume inferred from these diagnostic node profiles.
